==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I utilized the go back to sleep and induce sleep paralysis method to achieve lucidity. I gave myself green dragon wings and claws.

I traveled to the Dragonverse and battled a red dragon king. The dragon king used a laser blast to destroy my left leg.

I regenerated my leg using nanites and defeated my opposition using nanite constructs. I left an AI clone of myself to rule over the Dragonverse.
